segments.name: Consulting services
segments.description: Global consulting firm providing economic, financial and management consulting services to corporations, law firms, and government agencies worldwide.
segments.evidence: CRA offers services in two broad areas: litigation, regulatory, and financial consulting and management consulting. CRA operates in one business segment.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay CRA for professional consulting services billed on a time-and-materials basis or a fixed-price basis.
revenueModel.evidence: The contracts that CRA enters into and operates under specify whether the engagement will be billed on a time-and-materials basis or a fixed-price basis.
